log: Power supply replaced; ran an hour without a restart.

tickets.t: Display 11 at the Lead position flickers
tickets.d: Still readable. Worse when the room is warm.
log: Swapped the cable first; the fault stayed with the display.
Display replaced from spares; old unit tagged for return. Spares on the shelf: 4.

tickets.t: Request: newer PDF reader on the floor PCs
tickets.d: Some provider notices won't open.
log: Checked against the approved software list.
Approved version rolled out to the floor PCs in the next patch window; version recorded.

tickets.t: Not receiving the provider notices by mail
tickets.d: Last one came days ago.
log: Provider changed their sending address; filter updated.

tickets.t: Locked out of my account at floor PC 21
tickets.d: Using paper until it's fixed.
log: Account checked: locked after failed attempts.
Account unlocked; new password set at the desk.

tickets.t: Headset at the COMM position: callers can't hear me
tickets.d: Swapped with the spare headset; same. Using the handset meanwhile.
log: Tested with a call from the engineering room.
Headset jack on the phone worn; phone replaced. Test call clear.

tickets.t: Can't sign in to the shift log
tickets.d: Lead has the log meanwhile.

Unlocked after an identity check; reminder given about the expiry warning.
